base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_011" FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1."XCL_010" = T2."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2."XCL_003" = T3."XCL_023"
INNER JOIN attendance AS T4 ON T1."XCL_010" = T4."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN member AS T5 ON T4."XCL_002" = T5."XCL_034"

GROUP BY T1."XCL_010", T1."XCL_011"
HAVING SUM(T3."XCL_020") > 50
